description: The record shape for a skill-derived evaluation of one AI work product. A record binds a named review skill (code-review, tdd, impl-validator, ...) and its verdict (pass, warn, fail) to a digest-bound subject: a delegate run, a self-improve candidate, a plan, an RFI answer or another skill. The record is audit evidence consumed by the promotion gate and the Master audit surface. It is never authority and never knowledge.
why: The installed engineering skills produce structured judgement only as interactive prose, so a promotion can succeed on benchmark numbers while its review is failing or absent. One canonical, digest-bound record gives the gate a checkable input, gives the Master an audit trail, and gives the skill suite a way to be evaluated itself. Refusing authority-shaped fields keeps a verdict from being smuggled into a grant.

canonical_source.rule: Where this file and shared/sparknet-skill-eval.py could disagree, that module is what runs. The schema is the normative statement and tests pin the agreement.

eval_id.purpose: Stable identifier for this evaluation, unique per subject revision.

fields.name: the skill directory name, e.g. code-review
fields.digest: optional sha256 of the skill file the verdict was produced under

skill.purpose: Which review skill produced the verdict, and optionally which bytes of it.

fields.ref: 1..512 characters; run id, candidate id, plan path or answer id
fields.digest: optional sha256 binding the evaluated bytes

subject.purpose: What was evaluated. The ref is data, never a path a caller may follow.

verdict.purpose: The gate reads pass as promote-eligible, warn as advisory and fail as blocking.

items.rule: 1..200 characters; the stable rule id from the skill
items.message: 1..2000 characters; what and where, never a secret
items.location: optional 1..512 characters; file or section reference

fields.id: the evaluator identity, e.g. project-reviewer or the harness name
fields.model: optional pinned model tag when an agent evaluated

evaluator.purpose: Who produced the verdict, so a result can be reproduced or discounted.

body_sha256.purpose: Digest of the canonical record body without this field; tamper evidence.

verdict_consistency.warn: at least one finding and no block finding

boundaries.authority: none: a record cannot grant, revoke, approve, apply or sign
boundaries.knowledge: none: a record is audit evidence and never enters a vault, a KB, a corpus or an RFI answer
boundaries.storage: a run record, an audit log or a signed artefact; never a knowledge page
